markup.[[x]]: 重点形式：这个语法要你注意的词（橙底）
markup.{x}: 变化的部分：只用在 [[ ]] 里，例如 work{s}（橙底里加粗下划线）
markup.((x)): 变回原形的动词（虚线下划线）
markup.~~x~~: 错句里错的部分（删除线）

idea.title: 一句话说清
idea.text: 间接引语就是**转述别人说过的话**，不加引号。话是「以前说的」，所以动词常常**往过去退一步**；我、你、今天、这里这些词也要跟着换。

uses.en: My manager told me [[to]] ((update)) the doc.
uses.en_zh: 经理让我更新一下文档。

backshift.title: 动词往后退一步
backshift.rule: 转述时，动词往「过去」退一步。口诀：**现在变过去，过去变完成，will 变 would，can 变 could。**

items.rule: 一般现在时 → 一般过去时
items.en: "I work in Leeds." → He said he [[worked]] in Leeds.
items.zh: 「我在利兹工作。」→ 他说他在利兹工作。

items.rule: 一般过去时 → 过去完成时
items.en: "I fixed it." → She said she [[had fixed]] it.
items.zh: 「我修好了。」→ 她说她已经修好了。

items.en: "I'll call you." → He said he [[would]] call me.
items.zh: 「我会给你打电话。」→ 他说他会给我打电话。

items.en: "I can help." → She said she [[could]] help.
items.zh: 「我能帮忙。」→ 她说她能帮忙。

notes: 说的事到现在还对，也可以不退：He said Swift [[is]] easy to learn.

words.title: 人称、时间、地点跟着换
words.rule: 站在**转述的人**的角度重新说：「我」可能变成「他」，「明天」可能已经过去了，「这里」变成「那里」。

items.en: "I'll do it tomorrow." → He said he would do it [[the next day]].
items.zh: 「我明天做。」→ 他说他第二天做。

items.en: "I saw it yesterday." → She said she had seen it [[the day before]].
items.zh: 「我昨天看到的。」→ 她说她前一天看到的。

items.en: "I'm busy today." → He said he was busy [[that day]].
items.zh: 「我今天很忙。」→ 他说他那天很忙。

items.en: "I like it here." → She said she liked it [[there]].
items.zh: 「我喜欢这儿。」→ 她说她喜欢那儿。

words.tip: 如果是当天转述、还在同一个地方，today、here 就不用换。

sayTell.title: say 和 tell
sayTell.rule: **tell 后面一定要跟人**：tell me、tell him。**say 后面不直接跟人**，要跟人就说 say to me。

examples.en: She [[told]] me (that) the release was delayed.
He [[said]] to me that he was leaving.

wrong.bad: She ~~said me~~ that it was delayed.
wrong.good: She [[told]] me that it was delayed.

notes: that 在 said / told 后面常常省掉，口语里更常省。

questions.title: 转述问题
questions.rule: 转述问题时，**句子变回普通顺序**：主语在前，动词在后；不要 do / does / did，问号也去掉。没有疑问词的问题用 **if** 或 **whether**。

examples.en: "Are you free?" → He asked [[if]] I [[was]] free.
examples.zh: 「你有空吗？」→ 他问我有没有空。

examples.en: "Where do you live?" → She asked where I [[lived]].
examples.zh: 「你住哪儿？」→ 她问我住在哪儿。

examples.en: "Have you finished?" → He asked [[whether]] I [[had finished]].
examples.zh: 「你做完了吗？」→ 他问我做完了没有。

commands.title: 转述请求和命令
commands.rule: 别人让你做事：tell / ask + 人 + **to do**。让你别做：**not to do**。

examples.en: "Please check the logs." → He asked me [[to check]] the logs.
examples.zh: 「请看一下日志。」→ 他让我看一下日志。

examples.en: "Don't push to main." → She told us [[not to push]] to main.
examples.zh: 「别往 main 上推。」→ 她叫我们别往 main 上推。

examples.en: "Can you send me the file?" → Tom asked me [[to send]] him the file.
examples.zh: 「你能把文件发我吗？」→ Tom 让我把文件发给他。

this.meaning: 间接引语：转述，不加引号，动词后退

that.meaning: 直接引语：原话照搬，加引号

commonMistakes.why: tell 后面跟人，say 不直接跟人。
转述问题用普通顺序，不用 did。

commonMistakes.good: She told me [[not to]] touch it.

commonMistakes.why: 转述是非问题用 if / whether。
转述时 will 变 would。

accept: She said that she was tired.

quiz.prompt: 转述：Leo: "I work in Leeds." → Leo said he ...
quiz.answer: Leo said he worked in Leeds.
accept: Leo said that he worked in Leeds.
Leo said he works in Leeds.
quiz.explain: 一般现在时退成过去时：[[worked]]。

quiz.prompt: 转述：Amy: "I fixed it." → Amy said she ...
quiz.answer: Amy said she had fixed it.
accept: Amy said that she had fixed it.
quiz.explain: 过去时退成过去完成时：[[had fixed]]。

quiz.prompt: "I'll call you." → He said he ___ call me.

traps.note: 转述时 will 往后退成 would。

quiz.prompt: "I'll do it tomorrow." → He said he would do it ___.（一周后转述）
quiz.explain: 时间已经过去了，tomorrow 变成 [[the next day]]。

quiz.prompt: "I saw it yesterday." → She said she had seen it the day ___.
She ___ me that the release was delayed.
改错：She said me that she was leaving.
quiz.answer: She told me that she was leaving.
accept: She told me she was leaving.
She said to me that she was leaving.
She said that she was leaving.

quiz.prompt: 转述："Are you free?" → He asked ...
quiz.answer: He asked if I was free.
accept: He asked whether I was free.
He asked me if I was free.
He asked me whether I was free.

traps.input: He asked if was I free.
traps.note: 转述问题用普通顺序：I was。

quiz.explain: 是非问题用 [[if]]，顺序是 I was。

quiz.prompt: 转述："Where do you live?" → She asked ...
accept: She asked me where I lived.

traps.input: She asked where did I live.
traps.note: 转述问题不用 did，说 where I lived。

quiz.explain: 去掉 do，主语在前：where [[I lived]]。

quiz.prompt: 改错：He asked where did I work.
accept: He asked me where I worked.

quiz.prompt: 转述："Please check the logs." → He asked me ...
quiz.answer: He asked me to check the logs.

quiz.prompt: 转述："Don't push to main." → She told us ...
quiz.answer: She told us not to push to main.

quiz.prompt: 改错：She told me don't touch it.
quiz.answer: She told me not to touch it.
quiz.explain: 让别人别做：[[not to]] + 动词原形。

quiz.prompt: 改错：He asked that I was free.
quiz.answer: He asked if I was free.
accept: He asked whether I was free.
He asked me if I was free.
He asked me whether I was free.

quiz.explain: 不加引号、动词后退的是间接引语。

openTask.prompt: 转述你今天在会上或聊天里听到的 3 句话：一句陈述、一句问题、一句别人让你做的事。
rules: 动词按需要往后退一步（is → was，will → would）
转述问题用普通顺序，不用 do / does / did；请求用 to do / not to do
openTask.note: 规则判时态后退、语序和 to do（计分）；离线模型给更自然的说法（AI 建议，不计分）
